topology.feedback: Rfb1 VB->VSENSE 1 Mohm; Rfb2 VSENSE->0 13 kohm
topology.f2: Sf2 VD->f2_path opens at declared fault; Vf2sense f2_path->VB
topology.bypass: BYPASS=1 forces fault_raw low in protection.inc

requirements: Keep local-VD protection active and independently verified when VB feedback is disconnected
Define an energy-interruption path for VD local capacitance and source-fed inductor current independent of VB regulation and failed MOS gate command
Verify F2 indication and restart across charged, discharged, and residual VD/VB states
Ensure bypass negative controls are rejected before any electrical result can be mistaken for pass
limits: Static connectivity does not prove dynamic causality
VD screen excursion and missing detector/latch transitions do not establish physical failure mode
No component selection, threshold change, circuit edit, hardware guarantee, or acceptance claim
